approaches.title: Fixed-width bit scanning
approaches.summary: Checks each of the 32 bit positions and accumulates the set bits.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation scans all 32 bits using masking and right shifts.

approaches.title: Brian Kernighan’s algorithm
approaches.summary: Repeatedly clears the lowest set bit until the value becomes zero. The number of iterations equals the number of set bits.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces fixed-width scanning with Brian Kernighan’s algorithm, clearing one set bit per iteration.

approaches.title: Built-in population count
approaches.summary: Uses Rust’s built-in bit-counting method to compute the Hamming weight.

revisions.commitComment: built-in! compiles to popcnt instruction if supported
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 191: built-in! compiles to popcnt instruction if supported
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the manual loop with `count_ones()`, cast to `i32`.
